references.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (Act 709) s.12B, inserted by Act A1727
references.quote: A data controller that has reason to believe a personal data breach has occurred must notify the Commissioner within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of it, and where the breach causes or is likely to cause significant harm, notify the affected data subjects without unnecessary delay.

description: Personal-data breach and its notification workflow.

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) Part XVA
references.quote: An employer that receives a complaint of sexual harassment must inquire into it, and where the complaint is proven, take the disciplinary or other action the Part requires.

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
references.quote: An employee may apply for a variation of the hours, days or place of work; the employer must consider the application and give a written decision within sixty days of receiving it.

references.title: Income Tax Act 1967 (Act 53)
references.quote: The employer must notify the Director General of the cessation of an employee's employment and account for the tax due; the case records the date the employer actually received notice of the death.

references.title: Income Tax Act 1967 (Act 53)
references.quote: The employer must notify the Director General not less than thirty days before an employee is expected to leave Malaysia, so that tax clearance (CP21) can be issued; the case records the actual expected departure date.

references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
references.quote: Wages are paid through a bank account in the employee's name, unless the employee makes a written request for another method; the case holds the signed request and its effective date.

description: Request to pay wages outside a bank account.
